title: Coastal Vista Seacrest, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: COASTAL VISTA A Lakefront 30A Retreat for Rest and Connection
description_expanded: OverviewCOASTAL VISTA A Lakefront 30A Retreat for Rest and Connection WELCOME TO COASTAL VISTA Some places invite you to slow down the moment you arrive. Set quietly along the shores of Camp Creek Lake, Coastal Vista come together to create a rare, private dual-home retreat on 30A. where the water is calm, the pace is slower, and time feels just a little more meaningful. Mornings begin with coffee on the deck as the sun rises across the lake. You might see someone paddling quietly across the water or casting a fishing line from the dock while the rest of the house slowly wakes. Days unfold with ease. Bike to the beach, paddle across the lake to a quiet stretch of sand, or head to The Big Chill for casual dining, music, and evenings under the lights. And when the day winds down, everything becomes still again. The lake softens, the sky fades, and the group gathers, stories around the fire pit, a glass of wine on the balcony, and the simple joy of being together. This is more than a stay, it’s a place to reconnect, spread out, and experience 30A together while still enjoying space and privacy. THE SETTING Located along the peaceful waters of Camp Creek Lake in Seacrest, this unique pairing offers the best of 30A. Coastal dune lakes like this exist in only a few places in the world, creating a rare environment where freshwater and saltwater meet. The result is calm paddling waters, beautiful wildlife, and serene views just minutes from the Gulf. From your private dock, you can launch a kayak or paddle board and make a short 300-yard paddle to a quiet beach access. Prefer to stay on land? Gulf Lakes Public Beach Access is just ½ mile away by bike or foot, making beach days effortless. This rare combination of lakefront living and easy beach access is what makes this property truly special. OUTDOOR LIVING Life here naturally happens outside, with plenty of space to enjoy it. With two separate living areas, the outdoor experience expands, giving your group room to gather, relax, and play while still enjoying the peaceful lakefront setting. You’ll find: A private dock for fishing, relaxing, or launching paddles Multiple kayaks, paddle boards & pedal boats for exploring the lake 8 Bikes for cruising along 30A Spacious decks overlooking the water for morning coffee and sunset drinks Fire pit for evenings under the stars Beach chairs, umbrellas, and toys ready for your beach days Outdoor showers for rinsing off after the beach Whether you’re starting the morning with a paddle or ending the evening by the fire, the lake becomes part of the rhythm of your stay. THE HOME Coastal Vista offers the perfect balance of togetherness and privacy, making it ideal for large families, multiple families, or groups of friends. You will find: 5 bedrooms + loft space Multiple bathrooms for comfort and convenience Two full kitchens for shared meals or separate spaces Bright, open living areas designed for gathering Balconies and large windows overlooking the lake Each area maintains its own charm while allowing your group to stay close, connected, and comfortable. Sleeping Arrangements Level One (Sleeps 4) Primary Bedroom: Queen bed Second Bedroom: Two twin beds Levels Two and Three (Sleeps 8) Primary Bedroom: King bed Guest Bedroom: Queen bed Additional Bedroom + Loft Space: Twin beds / trundles (great for kids or extra guests) Total Combined Capacity: Up to 12 guests EXPLORE NEARBY 30A Tucked in a quiet lakeside setting, yet close to everything, this location offers the perfect balance of peace and accessibility. The Big Chill A favorite local gathering spot with restaurants, live music, outdoor movies, and family-friendly entertainment—just a quick bike ride away. From here, you can easily explore the best of 30A, from dining and shopping to the iconic white sand beaches and emerald waters. WHY GUESTS LOVE THIS PROPERTY Guests often say the most special part of staying here is the balance. You have the beauty and energy of the beach… and the quiet calm of the lake. You can spend your days exploring 30A or never leave the dock. With two homes, your group can gather together, while still enjoying space to unwind. It’s a place to paddle, fish, bike, relax, and reconnect together. A PLACE TO GATHER & SLOW DOWN Whether you're planning a family reunion, group getaway, or special celebration, Coastal Vista offers something rare on 30A, a place where everyone can be together, without feeling crowded. Coffee on the deck. Sunsets over the lake. Barefoot evenings around the fire. Welcome to your 30A retreat.Show less
